Module Contents
---------------

.. py:function:: save_markdown_report(result, path)

   Save a benchmark result as a Markdown report.

   :param result: Result object renderable by `render_markdown_report`.
   :param path: Destination file path.


.. py:function:: render_markdown_report(result)

   Render a benchmark result as Markdown.

   :param result: Benchmark result object.

   :returns: Markdown report text.
